message: and the tag scan never found it
$reason: `tag-swallowed-by-an-expression` with a template for the element: the false tag `<limit())` swallows an `<ng-template>` whose `tabindex` would fail point 1, as `stop-on-a-wrapped-template` does. The tree holds the template as a tag of its own, and the tree's tag offsets held against the scan's are those of templates as well as elements; holding the scan to the offsets of elements alone passed this one.
